author: nincreativestudio
title: NIN Creative Studio Hiring Illustrator Artists
content: NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: espoirschooloflife
title: Hiring Storybook Illustrator (Paid Project)
content: WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project) Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life. The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives, community impacts, and grassroots projects to life through vibrant illustrations. How to Apply: please fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI Be ready to share your: Contact Information, Portfolio Link, Expected Rate/Project Quotation

author: malakabooksid
title: Open call for Book Designers & Illustrators
content: FOR BOOK DESIGNERS & ILLUSTRATORS Malaka Books bakal menerbitkan beberapa buku baru. Nah, buat kamu para illustrator dan designer, kami lagi ngebuka kesempatan kolaborasi untuk terlibat langsung dalam proses penerbitan buku cetak. Tidak ada deadline ya, silahkan mendaftar jika tertarik, akan kami cek berkala. Tertarik buat gabung? Langsung isi formulir di sini ya bit.ly/talentmalakabooks #MalakaBooks #TalentMalakaBooks
